description: Renames a report of any type, moves it, or changes its timezone or failure notifications. Renaming a report that updates a file, such as a Google Slides presentation, also renames the file, as the app does. Only its editors may.

folderId.description: The folder to move the report to, by its `id` from `listFolders`; it must be one you can see. Pass `null` to move it to the top level, outside any folder. Members then get access to the report through the new folder, and the folders it's in, instead of the old one.

name.description: New name for the report, as members will see it in Rollstack. Leading and trailing spaces are removed, and it can't be blank.

notificationMailingList.description: Email addresses to copy when Rollstack emails the owner about a failed scheduled run, while `notifyOnFailure` is `true`. The list you send replaces the current one; send `[]` to clear it. Each address must belong to an active member of the organization, ignoring case. Up to 100 addresses, with no duplicates.

notifyOnFailure.description: Whether Rollstack should email the report's owner when a scheduled run fails or some of its datasheets fail to refresh, copying everyone in `notificationMailingList`. Set it to `false` to stop these emails. Runs started in the app or with `startReportRun` never send them.

timezone.description: The report's new timezone. The slides agent uses it to tell today's date, and the report's emails show the time of its last successful update (`{{last_updated_at}}`) in it. On a report that updates a file, it's also the timezone of the file's date variables, unless the organization's `timezone` replaces it. It doesn't change the report's schedules, which each have their own `timezone`: change those with `updateReportSchedules`. An IANA timezone name, such as `America/New_York`.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

name: updateReport
title: Update report
